# Environment variables (Enterprise Edition)

<!-- GENERATED by packages/ee-server/scripts/gen-env-reference-ee.ts (#734 / ADR-237 §2.2). Do not edit by hand. -->

Variables read only by the Enterprise Edition server: **3**. Everything else it reads is shared with the Community Edition and documented once, in the main reference.

| Variable | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MANAGED_EMAIL_API_KEY` | unset | API key for that service. It is sent as a bearer, so it is a credential rather than an identifier. |
| `MANAGED_EMAIL_API_URL` | unset (the managed sender is off) | Endpoint of the managed email service. With it unset the deployment falls back to SMTP, which is what a self-hosted Enterprise deployment usually wants. |
| `WKS_PSEUDONYM_PEPPER` | unset (required for the transparency ledger) | Secret pepper mixed into the pseudonyms in the access-transparency ledger, so a subject cannot be recovered by hashing candidate identifiers. Changing it makes existing pseudonyms unlinkable to new ones, which is a decision rather than a rotation. |

## Shared with the Community Edition

This package also reads `DATABASE_ADMIN_URL`, `DATABASE_URL`, `EMAIL_FROM`, `WIKISTEAD_OPERATOR`, `WIKISTEAD_TEST_STACK`, `WKS_BRAND_NAME` — see the main environment reference for those.
